# Achievements

> Every certification, course completion, badge and award earned by Amey
> Thakur, each linked to its original file and collected in one PDF, with
> issuer verification where it exists. Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, IBM,
> Intel, NVIDIA, Apple, Kaggle, Coursera, LinkedIn Learning, Stanford,
> Harvard and Cambridge, plus research and coursework.

Licence: see the repository
Repository created: 19 July 2021
